description: This file defines the CallbackStream class, which implements the PSR HTTP StreamInterface. It provides a stream implementation backed by a callback function, allowing lazy or dynamic stream content generation.

classes.name: CallbackStream
classes.description: Implementation of a stream that uses a callback to provide its contents, conforming to PSR-7 StreamInterface. Supports basic stream operations like getContents, detach, and metadata retrieval, but prevents seeking, writing, and reading from the stream directly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the CallbackStream with a provided callback function.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the stream's contents by invoking the callback.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream by nullifying the callback.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches and returns the callback function from the stream.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Attaches a new callback function to the stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns null as size is indeterminate.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Throws exception as the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Returns true if the stream has no callback attached.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not seekable.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws exception as the stream cannot be seeked.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Throws exception as the stream cannot be rewound.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws exception as the stream is unwritable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream is not directly readable; reading is handled via callback.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Throws exception as reading from the stream directly is unsupported.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Invokes the callback to retrieve contents, detaching it in the process.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata about the stream; supports querying specific metadata keys.
